verdict.rationale: A probe fetched https://docs.speechischeap.com/openapi.json with HTTP 200 and found an "openapi" key, so a machine-readable OpenAPI spec can be downloaded from the docs origin. The llms.txt and .md doc mirrors add agent-readable context but are not the spec itself. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or linking the spec, and evidence of which APIs it covers (Jobs, x402, Edge) and how complete or current it is.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://docs.speechischeap.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
